title: The Three Angels' Messages
description: Three angels fly through heaven with solemn messages: the first proclaims an eternal gospel and calls nations to fear God and worship the Creator, the second announces that Babylon the great has fallen, and the third warns against worshipping the beast or receiving its mark, which leads to torment by fire and sulfur before the Lamb and the angels. The vision concludes with a call for the endurance of the saints and a blessing on those who die in the Lord.
